thread:
Priya: heads up — the runtime guide preview is returning a 502 intermittently and the shortlink in /kb/runtime/kv-cache points at a 404 now. repro steps below. :eyes:

Jamal: ugh, thanks. any quick repro you can paste here? which page exactly?

Priya: page: /kb/runtime/kv-cache#ttl-behavior
curl -I https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/kb/runtime/kv-cache | sed -n '1,10p'
---
HTTP/2 302
location: /s/rl/short/abc123

HTTP/2 404
content-type: text/html
---
seems like the shortlink resolver is returning a 302 to an S3 key that doesn't exist sometimes, which then surfaces as a 502 in the preview pipeline.

Kara: @Priya can you drop the markdown snippet where the shortlink is used? i'll do a small PR to swap it to the canonical path if that's quickest. :+1:

Priya: snippet is `See the TTL notes in [KV caching](/s/rl/short/abc123)` — can replace with `/kb/runtime/kv-cache#ttl-behavior` directly.

Jamal: quick check: is that shortlink used elsewhere? run `git grep -n "abc123"` — might be a handful of places incl ja/ and es/ locales.

Kara: i'll run the grep in a branch, open a tiny PR that replaces occurrences with the real path and update the codeowners entry if needed. planning to target the docs repo main branch and request a staging deploy.

docs-bot: staging deploy started for commit 7f3b9c — preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/7f3b9c (will be ready in ~3m)

Liam: quick ask — if you replace the shortlink, can you add a small note in the PR description for localized owners? we should either backfill translations or leave localized pages pointing at the new canonical path. otherwise risk more 404s.

Kara: opening PR now — https://git.internal.redwood.ai/docs/merge_requests/4567 — title: "replace broken shortlink -> canonical kv-cache path". PR body lists files changed and locales touched (ja/es). tagged @Liam for locale decisions and @Jamal for quick tech check.

Priya: thank you!! i'll watch the preview and queue a CR. if staging shows the 502 gone i can mark the runtime guide task done. :pray:

Jamal: i'll skim the change, if it's just replacing literal links LGTM and will merge once CI passes. also filing a short incident note so eng-platform can look at the shortlink resolver behavior separately.

docs-bot: preview ready — https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/7f3b9c (screenshots compiled)

Liam: noted, i'll coordinate with intl on whether to backfill or add redirect mappings. thanks for flagging the locales in the PR, Kara.

Kara: merged after CI green. tagging this thread with #ownership for the runbook — @eng-platform PTAL at the shortlink resolver logs when you have a sec.

Priya: confirmed preview no longer 502s for me and the link lands correctly. closing the loop here. thanks everyone! :tada:
